description: The main window: native-menu, update-status and sign-in-link events, dragging the window by the macOS toolbar rows, opening allowlisted https links, public https job-posting links and webmail inboxes, the app's own update commands (status, check, restart to update, Stable/Beta channel) and sign-in commands (take the checked sign-in link, report the signed-in state to the menu). The updater and deep-link plugins' commands are not granted.
